title: Belief
author: Simple English Wikipedia contributors
paragraphs: A belief is a firm thought that something is true, often based on revelation. Belief is usually a part of belonging to a religion. It is different to scientific knowledge that can be tested, but belief is not able to be tested. The word is also used to describe what a person expects will happen based on limited information.
For instance, a person may believe in God or gods, while "I believe Amy will come around today" can also be a belief. Belief is also something you believe in but you cannot prove exactly.
